title: Dolce & Gabbana White Calfskin Nappa New Roma Sneakers
description:

The New Roma style is the result of the fusion between the brand’s iconic sneakers. Roma and Miami. Contemporary and versatile, it is inspired by the basketball scene. It comes in calfskin nappa and features the DG logo on the tongue.

The Ace sneaker is crafted from GG Supreme canvas and further enhanced by the House Web in blue and red. Eye-catching chromatic accents, such as blue and red leather details at the back and a contrasting white sole, add a playful twist.

It's presented here in blue GG Crystal canvas, while a metal “ACE” tag shines atop the lace-up closure. Gucci's distinctive green and red Web stripe completes the style.

  • Green and red Web
